claim_summary: For every \(d\ge3\), each four-by-four Walsh character minor on \(\mathbb F_2^d\) has determinant magnitude 0, 8, or 16; explicit factored polynomials give the exact numbers for each magnitude and each real rank 1 through 4.
integrity: Proof uses affine geometry, complete eight-vertex cube enumeration by classification, and occupancy inclusion-exclusion. Exhaustive independent integer checks cover orders eight and sixteen. No independent scientific audit or novelty certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unnormalized elementary abelian binary Fourier character matrices, minor size four only; no claim for cyclic groups, arbitrary Hadamard matrices or other minor sizes; equivalent older classification remains possible.
title: Exact rank and determinant spectra of four-point Walsh Fourier minors
